title: HB472 (2020 General): Conceal Carry Firearms Amendments

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Utah) (gun-policy Stage 5, Utah); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Utah text (Introduced, ; official copy, https://le.utah.gov/~2020/bills/hbillint/HB0472.pdf (Open States text id 90096894))
provenance.note: Introduced version (03-04-20). No later amendments considered. Section 1 only keeps the loaded-long-gun-in-vehicle ban in place against the new exemption.

operative_text:
Section 2 (Utah Code 76-10-523): (5) Subsection 76-10-504(1) does not apply to a person 21 years old or older who may otherwise lawfully possess a firearm.
Section 1 (Utah Code 76-10-505): (3) Notwithstanding Subsections (1)(a)(i) and (ii), and Subsection 76-10-523(5), a person may not possess a loaded rifle, shotgun, or muzzle-loading rifle in a vehicle.
